decisions.reason: Adding a header menu and related pages does not change the established dark theme or its applicability to website pages.
The new header menu does not necessarily remove or alter the shared footer, its content, or its footer navigation links.
The source does not state that policy links move from the footer to the header menu or that their PDF and new-tab behavior changes.
The addition of website header navigation does not change the Cognito sign-in page's branding or required visual elements.
The source provides no necessary change to the landing page's responsive behavior or breakpoint requirements.
Message 95 independently updates the Admin Workspace styling requirement, but the website header-menu decision does not propagate a further change to that requirement.
Adding a header menu and related pages does not alter the established plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
The source does not modify the landing page's section order, How It Works content, or copy plan.
The header-menu addition neither removes nor modifies the required landing-page sign-up button.
The source does not change the landing page's visual concepts, colors, typography, or unresolved logo treatment.
The addition of website navigation does not entail a change to hero-text emphasis or other hero presentation behavior.
Message 95 independently introduces the production-ready solution-page diagram deliverable; the header-navigation modification does not alter that diagram requirement.
